description: Hexagonal ditched enclosure, the ditch provided dating from 150 BCE to 50 CE. At the centre of the enclosure appeared to be a robbed out Late Iron Age cremation burial. Adjacent to the enclosure was an Iron Age - Anglo Saxon cremation cemetery. The RSRB marks this site as a 'shrine.'
bibliography: Allen, Martyn, Tom Brindle, Alex Smith, Julian D Richards, Tim Evans, Neil Holbrook, Michael Fulford, and Nathan Blick. “The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: An Online Resource.” Archaeology Data Service, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
